panel.resumen: Does anyone else have photos? <enlace>Ask them with a link</enlace>
panel.resumenActivo: <enlace>Your link to ask for photos</enlace> · open until {fecha}
panel.resumenCaducado: <enlace>Your link to ask for photos</enlace> · no longer takes new photos
panel.texto: Create a link and send it on WhatsApp or however you like. Anyone who opens it can send you photos from their phone, no sign-up needed.
panel.privacidad: They arrive encrypted: they only open in this browser, which is where your deck is saved.
panel.mensaje: I'm making a card deck with our memories. Could you send me your photos? You can upload them here:
panel.ninguna: None have arrived yet. We check every so often.
panel.llegadas: {n, plural, one {# photo has arrived} other {# photos have arrived}}
panel.yaNoAdmite: The link no longer takes new photos, but you can still add the ones that arrived.
panel.inactivo: Your previous link is no longer active: it expired or was closed. If you'd like more photos, create a new one.
panel.cerrarConfirmar: Close the link? Nobody else will be able to send you photos with it.
panel.cerrarConFotos: {n, plural, one {Close the link? Nobody else will be able to send you photos with it, and the photo you haven't added yet will be deleted.} other {Close the link? Nobody else will be able to send you photos with it, and the # you haven't added yet will be deleted.}}
panel.errorRed: We couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
panel.errorOcupado: No more links can be created right now. Try again in a while.
panel.errorLlave: This browser won't save the link's key (are you in a private window?). Try in a normal window.
panel.sinRed: We couldn't check for new photos. We'll try again in a moment.

aportar.intro: Someone is making a card deck with your shared memories and would love your photos. Pick the ones you like: they arrive with the date they were taken.
aportar.consejo: Tip: in Apple Photos or Google Photos, search by person or place to find them faster.
aportar.nombreAyuda: So they know who sent them.
aportar.consentimiento: I have permission from the people in the photos, and from their parents if they are minors, to send them.
aportar.consentimientoFalta: Tick this box to send the photos.
aportar.enviadas: {n, plural, one {Done! # photo has arrived.} other {Done! # photos have arrived.}}
aportar.repetidas: {n, plural, one {# was already sent} other {# were already sent}}
aportar.fallidas: {n, plural, one {# couldn't be sent} other {# couldn't be sent}}
aportar.noImagen: {n, plural, one {# file isn't a photo} other {# files aren't photos}}
aportar.lleno: This deck can't take more photos for now: many are waiting to be added. Try again later.
aportar.privacidad1: Before leaving your phone, each photo is resized and encrypted: only the person making the deck can open it.
aportar.privacidad2: Your location and other photo data aren't sent, only the date.
aportar.privacidad3: They're deleted from the server as soon as they're added to the deck, or when the link expires.
aportar.noExiste: This link no longer works. Ask the person who sent it to create a new one.
aportar.caducado: This link has expired. Ask the person who sent it to create a new one.
aportar.incompleto: The link is incomplete. Open the whole link, exactly as you received it.
aportar.sinRed: We couldn't open the link. Check your connection and try again.
aportar.pie: Private prototype. The photos are only used for this deck.
